                                     1. PROJECT INTRODUCTION

           The Project is proposed at the intersection of Smith Road and Allen Road in Eden,

Maryland. The Project has an approximately 22.18-acre limit of disturbance and 16.31 -acre limit

of construction within an approximately 45.53-acre properry identified as Tax Map 0057. Grid

0009. Parcel 0062 in Wicomico County, Maryland (the " Property"). The Property consists of

agricu ltural fields and wooded areas and is located within an Agricultural-Rural zone.

Approximately 0.0 acres within the limit of disturbance are classified as prime fannland and

approximately 7.68 acres as farmland of statewide importance. ERD at Table 2.

           The Project will be a 4.70 MWac photovoliaic generating station that will allocate energy

to community solar subscribers within Delmarva Power & Light ("DPL"') service territory. The

Project will interconnect at 25 kV with tbe Fruitland substation. ERO at§ Jl.J.

           During the construction phase, wh ich is estimated to last siJ< to twelve months, the Project

is expected to involve approximately $8,494,200 in capital spend ing and approximately 54.8

design, management, and construction personnel, including 21. 1 direct, 9.2 indirect, and 12.2

induced positions at the height of construction. The Project is also expected to suppo11

approximately 2.0 local jobs annually during the first five years following construction.

       Maryland requires 50% of electricity sales to be supported by renewable energy credits by

2030, including 14.5% from solar energy by 2028. The Project will contribute 4.70 MWac of

com munity solar generation ioward those requirements.

       In summary, there are compelling economic, environmental, a11d legal reasons for ~1e State

and lhe Commission to expeditiously approve this CPCN application, with no countervail ing harm .

Accordingly, the App licant respectfully requesis that the Commission expeditiously approve the

Project.
